# HRNet-Footprint-Trainer

> Train HRNet building-footprint segmentation on your own orthophotos. Sliding-window dataset generation from large GeoTIFFs plus building vectors, MMSegmentation training, and overlapping sliding-window inference over arbitrarily large images.

Three scripts form one pipeline: large orthophoto plus building vector labels,
turned into a tiled dataset, used to train an HRNet segmentation model, which is
then applied to full-size imagery with seamless stitching.

This is for the case where a general-purpose remote-sensing model is inaccurate
on your imagery (different season, sensor, or urban texture) but you have local
building vector data. Rather than fine-tuning someone else's checkpoint, train a
dedicated one.

## Entry points

- `prepare/prepare_dataset_multiprocess.py` - sliding-window tiling with
  foreground-ratio filtering and NoData handling. Reads `prepare/DATA.TXT`
  (copy from `DATA.example.TXT`) or `--config <path>`. Fully incremental: existing
  patches are skipped. Outputs `dataset/{train,val}/{images,masks,masks_vis}`
  plus `train_list.txt` / `val_list.txt`.
- `train.py` - full MMSegmentation config in a Python dict: HRNet-W48 backbone,
  FCNHead, CrossEntropy + Dice loss, SGD with PolyLR. Defines the
  `FootprintDataset` and the `MaskNoData` transform.
- `predict.py` - overlapping sliding-window inference. Flags: `--input`,
  `--checkpoint`, `--output`, `--crop-size`, `--stride`, `--device`.
  Writes a binary mask and a `_vis` visualisation, both georeferenced.
- `scripts/download_models.py` - downloads the reference HRNet-W48 checkpoint
  with SHA256 verification.

## Key design points

The `MaskNoData` transform sets pure black `(0,0,0)` and pure white
`(255,255,255)` regions of each patch to `255` in the label, which is
MMSegmentation's `ignore_index`. Image borders therefore never contribute to the
loss. Patches whose building pixel ratio falls outside `[0.01, 0.98]` are
discarded, cutting training time without costing accuracy. Inference uses 50%
overlapping windows, which both works around GPU memory limits and removes seam
artifacts.

## Reference checkpoint

HRNet-W48 + FCNHead, about 542 MB, served from the sibling project's release:
`https://github.com/UVE1048/Footprint-Creater/releases/download/models-v1/hrnet_w48_iter_6000.pth`
SHA256 `73db3f97998fc62cbbcb83897925d1c6ffaef2e1dadd78b5b7f90267dab5cf18`.
